description: Use this when someone asks about large transfers in or out of exchanges, or an exchange's inflows and outflows. Large transfers of BTC, ETH, USDT and USDC read block by block from the Bitcoin, Ethereum and Tron networks, with the exchange named when a known exchange wallet is on either side, plus each exchange's money in, money out and net flow over 24 hours, and a record of what the price did one, four and 24 hours after each kind of move beside how often it is lower after any hour. With an exchange named, that exchange's own inflow, outflow and net flow per asset and its latest transfers. Answers "did whales just move bitcoin to an exchange", "which exchange saw the biggest inflow today", "what is Binance's net flow today", "any large USDT transfers in the last hour" and "does bitcoin fall after it is sent to exchanges". Live market data, not advice.
